subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external-channel source replies keep automatic bare-text delivery by default, or should channel delivery require an explicit final/message-tool boundary before user-visible output is sent?
rationale: The safer default reduces internal text leaks, but changing it can break existing users who rely on automatic conversational replies without message tools or final tags.

options.title: Default to safer channel delivery
options.body: Make external-channel delivery final-only or message-tool-bound by default, with migration notes and regression coverage for current channel and cron paths.

options.title: Ship an opt-in guard first
options.body: Preserve automatic delivery as the default while adding a documented final-only or message-tool-only mode for users who need stricter leak protection.

options.title: Limit fixes to provider-specific leaks
options.body: Keep automatic delivery as the product default and only patch known commentary or provider-specific narration bugs.

recommendation.title: Default to safer channel delivery
recommendation.body: Make external-channel delivery final-only or message-tool-bound by default, with migration notes and regression coverage for current channel and cron paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent delivery-hardening work makes this the best available owner for the policy and upgrade-safety decision.
